mapper.select: SELECT f.vloger_id as vlogerId, u.nickname as nickname, u.face as face, 1 as isFollowed FROM fans f LEFT JOIN users u ON f.vloger_id = u.id WHERE f.fan_id = #{myId} ORDER BY f.id DESC
SELECT f.fan_id as fanId, u.nickname as nickname, u.face as face, f.is_fan_friend_of_mine as isFriend FROM fans f LEFT JOIN users u ON f.fan_id = u.id WHERE f.vloger_id = #{myId} ORDER BY f.id DESC
